items.title: Anthropic launches Cowork, a Claude Desktop agent that works in your files — no coding required
items.summary: Anthropic released Cowork on Monday, a new AI agent capability that extends the power of its wildly successful Claude Code tool to non-technical users — and according to company insiders, the team built the entire feature in approximately a week and a half, largely using Claude Code itself. The launch marks a major inflection point in the race to deliver practical AI agents to mainstream users, positioning Anthropic
items.summaryZh: Anthropic发布了Claude Desktop的AI代理功能“Cowork”，旨在为非技术用户提供自动化文件处理能力。该功能允许AI直接读取本地文件、整理数据并生成报告，无需用户编写代码。Cowork的开发基于Claude Code的成功经验，旨在通过自动化日常办公任务，在生产力工具市场与微软Copilot等竞品展开竞争，体现了AI代理在企业办公场景中的落地趋势。
